strongest_angle: In November 2026, a majority of Australian work health and safety ministers committed to regulatory reforms to address the persistent trend of fatal quad bike incidents in agricultural workplaces.

key_facts.fact: A majority of work health and safety ministers agreed on November 17, 2026, to progress new regulatory reforms aimed at strengthening quad bike safety in Australian workplaces.
Between 2021 and 2025, 73 people died in quad bike incidents across Australia, representing an average of nearly 15 deaths per year.
Since 2011, 245 people have died in quad bike related incidents in Australia, with 43 of those victims aged 19 or under.
As of November 5, 2026, there have been 17 recorded quad bike fatalities in Australia for the calendar year.
